description: Starter characters: the parameter values a new character starts from (todo 1.3). 'woman' is the default: an adult of about 30 with the look the owner's reference images share (2026-11-24; AI and game stills, kept out of the repository): fit and toned, an hourglass build with a narrow waist, fuller bust, hips and glutes and long legs, high cheekbones over slim cheeks, a tapered jaw and defined chin, full lips, a narrow nose, larger almond eyes with lifted outer corners, arched brows set higher, dense lashes, longer hair, and the references' makeup: winged liner, a smudged lower lash line, warm brown shadow, glossy rose lips with liner, blush, contour and highlight. Not any one person's or character's likeness. 'man' is a fit adult man; 'average' keeps every registry default (the ANSUR II mean woman). Values are registry ids and values (three numbers for a colour, linear Rec.709); a starter's 'hair' is the scalp style a viewer shows it with. The lean, tapered face comes from face.shape.sculpt (one smooth field); the semantic face axes move features by about a millimetre per unit (todo 1.1: to be calibrated to population SDs) and large values of the cheek and jaw axes leave ridges, so the starter keeps them at 0.
